title: The 138-Year Coca-Cola Secret
title_options: Why Nobody Can Copy Coca-Cola's 138-Year Formula
The DEA Secret Inside Every Bottle of Coke
script_full: For 138 years, people thought Coca-Cola's secret formula was locked in an Atlanta vault. The truth is far stranger. Only one company in America has a federal license to import raw coca leaves: the Stepan chemical plant in New Jersey. Under strict DEA supervision, they extract the cocaine for pharmaceuticals, sending the spent flavor extract exclusively to Coca-Cola. Competitors can copy the chemistry, but no one on Earth can copy a federal monopoly. The secret isn't in a vault. It's in the law.
